questions.question: The graph of y = f(x) is shown in the xy−plane. For what value of x does f(x) = 0?
questions.explanation: f(x) = 0 where the graph crosses the x-axis, which is at x = 4.

questions.question: What is an x-intercept of the graph of the equation y = (x + 8)(x − 11)(x + 12) in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: y = 0 when x = −8, 11 or −12, so (11, 0) is an x-intercept.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = 15x + 910. For what value of x does f(x) = 1?

−5x + 15rx = 135

As part of a science experiment on evaporation, Ella measured the height of water in a glass over a period of time. The function f(x) = 39 − 0.18x gives the estimated height, in centimeters (cm), of the water in the glass x days after the start of the experiment. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 39 in this context?
options: The estimated height, in cm, of the water at the start of the experiment
The estimated height, in cm, of the water at the end of the experiment
The estimated change in the height, in cm, of the water each day
The estimated number of days for all the water to evaporate

questions.question:

T(x) = 34(26x7 − 800) + 15.50

If a temperature increased by 3.3 degrees Torte, by how much did the temperature increase, in degrees Celsius? (Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.)

I. a = 9

II. b = 5

III. b ≠ 59

y = x2 + 1.3

II. g(x) = −(x + 4)2 + 7
Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which data set has the greatest mean?
questions.explanation: Choices A, C and D are symmetric around 65, so each has mean 65. Choice B has more weight on the larger values: 1480/22 ≈ 67.3.

questions.question: The walls of a small apartment were covered using exactly 3 gallons of paint. The paint was spread uniformly over a total area of 960 square feet. What was the rate, in gallons per square foot, at which the paint was used?
questions.topic: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units

questions.question: During hibernation, American black bears do not eat or replenish calories. A certain black bear weighed 293 pounds when entering hibernation and lost weight at a mean rate of 0.9 pounds per day. At this rate, how many days after entering hibernation would the black bear weigh 230 pounds?
questions.explanation: The bear must lose 293 − 230 = 63 pounds, which takes 63 ÷ 0.9 = 70 days.

questions.question: In 2013, Chloe earned 11% more than in 2012, and in 2014 Chloe earned 6% more than in 2013. If Chloe earned y times as much in 2012 as in 2014, which of the following is closest to the value of y?
The function f is defined by f(x) = (x − 9)(x − 6)(x − 5). In the xy-plane, the graph of y = g(x) is the result of translating the graph of y = f(x) up 4 units. What is the value of g(0)?

(x − 3)2 + (y + 7)2 = 25
The given equation represents circle P in the xy−plane. Circle Q has a center that is 1 unit to the right of and 2 units below the center of circle P. Circle Q has a diameter that is double the diameter of circle P. Which equation represents circle Q?
questions.explanation: Circle P has center (3, −7) and radius 5. Circle Q has center (4, −9) and radius 10, so r² = 100.

questions.question: A rectangle has a length that is 31 times its width. The function y = (31w)(w) represents this situation, where y is the area, in square feet, of the rectangle and y > 0. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 31w in this context?
options: The length of the rectangle, in feet
The area of the rectangle, in square feet
The difference between the length and width of the rectangle, in feet
The width of the rectangle, in feet
questions.explanation: The length is 31 times the width w, so 31w is the length of the rectangle in feet.

questions.question: The measure of angle K is π2(12) radians. The measure of angle L is 12 times the measure of angle K. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle L?
questions.explanation: Angle L = 12 × π/24 = π/2 radians, which is 90°.

questions.question: A research manager selected 2 random samples of ovens of a certain type to estimate the average amount of time this type of oven takes to preheat to 325 degrees Fahrenheit (°F). The research manager recorded the amount of time, in minutes, each oven takes to preheat to 325°F. Based on the first sample, the research manager estimated that this type of oven takes an average of 15.2 minutes to preheat to 325°F, with an associated margin of error of 1 minute. Based on the second sample, the research manager estimated that this type of oven takes an average of 15.4 minutes to preheat to 325°F, with an associated margin of error of 2.2 minutes. Assuming the margins of error were calculated the same way, which of the following best explains why the first sample obtained a smaller margin of error than the second sample?
options: The first sample contained more ovens than the second sample.
The first sample contained fewer ovens than the second sample.
The first sample took more time on average to preheat to 325°F than the second sample.
The first sample took less time on average to preheat to 325°F than the second sample.
questions.explanation: A larger sample gives a smaller margin of error.

questions.question: In the figure shown, line r is parallel to line s, and line t intersects both lines. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The angle x° at line s corresponds to the 121° angle at line r, and corresponding angles of parallel lines are equal, so x = 121.

questions.question: Demarcus has 200 Japanese yen (JPY). He needs to exchange Hong Kong dollars (HKD) for more JPY. The exchange rate is 14 JPY for every HKD. Which function f gives the total amount, in JPY, Demarcus will have after exchanging x HKD?

Which equation represents this situation, where x is the number of cones purchased and y is the number of sundaes purchased?

In a set of four consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by z. The product of 24 and the third odd integer in the set is at most 86 less than the sum of the first and fourth odd integers in the set. What is the greatest possible value of z?

questions.question:
124x2 + (s − 124t)x − st = 0
In the given equation, s and t are positive constants. The product of the solutions to the given equation is −2kst, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: The product of the roots is c/a = (−st)/(1/24) = −24st. Setting this equal to −2kst gives k = 12.

questions.question: If 121x<sup>2</sup> = −110x + 56, what is the value of 11x + 5, where 11x + 5 > 0?
questions.explanation: Let u = 11x. Then u^2 + 10u − 56 = 0, so (u + 14)(u − 4) = 0 and u = −14 or 4. Then 11x + 5 = −9 or 9, and only 9 is positive.

questions.question: A quadratic function gives the estimated length of daylight d(t), in hours, in a certain city t months after March 1, where 0 ≤ t ≤ 7. According to the function, the estimated length of daylight is 12.66 hours 6 months after March 1 and the maximum estimated length of daylight is 13.91 hours 3.5 months after March 1. Based on this function, what is the estimated length of daylight, in hours, on March 1?

146x2 + (s − 146t)x − st = 0
In the given equation, s and t are positive constants. The product of the solutions to the given equation is −2kst, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: The product of the solutions is c/a = −st ÷ (1/46) = −46st. Setting −46st = −2kst gives k = 23.

questions.question:
I. f(x) = a(3.3)x + b
II. g(x) = a(3.3)x + b
The functions f and g are defined by the equations shown, where a and b are integer constants, a < b and b < 0. If y = f(x) and y = g(x) are graphed in the xy-plane, which of the following equations displays, as a constant or coefficient, the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of the corresponding function?
questions.explanation: For I the y-intercept is a(3.3)^b, and for II it is a + b; neither value appears as a constant or coefficient in its equation.

questions.question: The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y. Which of the following equations is the most appropriate model for the data shown?
questions.explanation: The points rise roughly along a straight line with a slope near 1 and a small negative y-intercept, so the linear model y = −582 + 1.2x fits. The others decrease or grow exponentially.

questions.question:
The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y. A line of best fit is also shown.
Which of the following is closest to the slope of this line of best fit?
questions.explanation: The line passes through about (0, 12) and (11, 0), so the slope is about −12/11 ≈ −1.1.

questions.question: Harper has $110 in an account. Each year she expects to have 2.7% more money in the account than she had the previous year. Which of the following models best describes how Harper expects the money in her account to change over time?
questions.explanation: Gaining 2.7% of the previous year's amount each year means multiplying by 1.027, which is increasing exponential growth.

questions.question: A triathlon is a multisport race consisting of three different legs. A triathlon participant completed the cycling leg with an average speed of 17.700 miles per hour. What was the average speed, in <u>yards</u> per hour, of the participant during the cycling leg? (1 mile = 1,760 yards)
questions.explanation: Multiply by the conversion factor: 17.7 × 1,760 = 31,152 yards per hour.

questions.question: In △DEF, the measure of ∠D is 114°. Which of the following could be the measure, in degrees, of ∠E?
The measure of angle B is 3π4 radians. What is the value of sin(B)?
questions.explanation: 3π/4 is 135°, in quadrant II with reference angle 45°, so sin(B) = √2/2.

questions.question: Circle K has a radius of 11 millimeters (mm). Circle L has an area of 144π mm<sup>2</sup>. What is the total area, in mm<sup>2</sup>, of circles K and L?
questions.explanation: Circle K has area 121π, so the total is 121π + 144π = 265π.

questions.question: A container has a volume of 0.84 cubic meters. Which of the following is closest to this volume, in quarts? (Note: 100.00 centimeters = 1 meter. Use 946.35 cubic centimeters = 1.00 quart.)

Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where angle A corresponds to angle D and angles C and F are right angles. The length of AB is 2.4 times the length of DE. If tan A = 2120, what is the value of sin D?
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles of similar triangles are equal, so sin D = sin A. With tan A = 21/20 the legs are 21 and 20, so the hypotenuse is 29 and sin A = 21/29.
